drg.description: Simple Pneumonia and Pleurisy with CC

timeline.text: Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. 79-year-old male admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.58, creatinine 1.11-1.37, hemoglobin 14.2, platelets 285-292, sodium 138, wbc 7.2-7.4; vitals dbp 66-71, heart_rate 71-74, map 85-91, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 14-16, sbp 122-130, spo2 97-98, temp 36.7-36.8
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Type 2 diabetes. Hypertension. Acute kidney injury.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 1.72-1.99, hemoglobin 14.2-14.3, platelets 283-288, sodium 138, wbc 7.7; vitals dbp 67-70, heart_rate 71-75, map 86-89, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 14-16, sbp 122-129, spo2 97-99, temp 36.6-36.8
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Hold lisinopril; Lactated Ringer's 1 L IV bolus
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Type 2 diabetes. Hypertension. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 79-year-old male, length of stay 5 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Type 2 diabetes. Hypertension. Acute kidney injury, resolved. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient seen and examined at bedside.
